response.justification: The candidate is an experienced senior full-stack engineer with strong web, backend, and tooling depth, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this embedded security role. There is no Japanese language ability listed (native-level Japanese is a hard requirement), no Linux kernel source-level work, and no experience with LAN-switch firmware, L2/L3 networking, MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP/NETCONF, or chip-vendor SDKs. C experience is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint at National Instruments over a decade ago, with the last ten years focused on TypeScript/Node.js/DLang web systems. The mismatch on mandatory qualifications makes this a clear pass.
strengths: 15+ years of software development experience with strong engineering craft (TDD, CI/CD, DevOps)
Some low-level exposure: C/C++ at National Instruments, C++/Linux/JACK audio thesis, D systems programming
Proven ability to learn new stacks quickly across web, mobile, desktop, and hardware-adjacent projects
concerns: No evidence of Japanese language proficiency, a stated hard requirement
No embedded networking, switch, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
No Linux kernel analysis or source-modification experience; C skills are dated and secondary

key_factors.factor: Weak/dated C and Linux kernel background
